h2: Regular Pool Service Uluwatu – Scheduled Care for Cliff-Top Villas
intro: If your villa sits on the Bukit and you're not here every day, a Regular Pool Service Uluwatu schedule keeps the water clear and the equipment honest while you're away. We handle the full cycle — testing, cleaning, pump checks — and send you a photo report on WhatsApp after each visit so nothing surprises you when you land back at Ngurah Rai.

sections.h3: Why Salt Wind and Limestone Water Change Everything Here
sections.text: Living on the dry limestone Bukit means your pool battles two forces most pools elsewhere never face: fine ocean salt mist and hard alkaline water. In Ungasan and Balangan, cliff-top villas collect a steady film of salt on skimmer baskets, pump housings and exposed metal fittings. The mineral-rich supply then deposits calcium scale across tiles and heater elements between visits. A consistent service rhythm catches both problems early, before they turn into costly part replacements or tile damage.

sections.h3: What Each Visit Covers and How You Get the Report
sections.text: Every scheduled stop follows the same checklist so nothing slips through: vacuum the floor, brush the walls, empty and rinse the skimmer basket, test pH and chlorine, top up chemicals, and give the pump and filter a once-over for wear. Because long pipe runs and large storage tanks put extra strain on pressure switches around this area, we listen for unusual noise and verify flow rates each time. Afterward you receive a WhatsApp message with photos of the pool, your water readings, and a short note on what was done.

sections.h3: Typical Issues We See Around Bingin and Pecatu
sections.text: Villas in that stretch tend to hit the same recurring problems year after year: salt-crusted pump seals, float valves sticking from mineral buildup in the tanks, and algae blooms during wet months when rain dilutes chlorine faster than usual. If you're away from Bali for weeks at a time, these small shifts go unnoticed until the water turns cloudy or the pump trips its overload relay. A weekly or fortnightly visit catches them while they're still a chemical adjustment rather than a hardware swap.

sections.h3: Getting Started – What to Send on WhatsApp
sections.text: Before your first booking, snap a few photos of the pool area, the pump housing and any visible scale on tiles, then send them over WhatsApp along with your villa address and preferred visit frequency. If you know your tank capacity or well depth, include that too — it helps us gauge how hard the whole system works day to day. In between visits, wiping salt residue off exposed fittings after a windy week and keeping the skimmer basket clean will slow corrosion noticeably.

faq.q: How often should I schedule pool service in Uluwatu?
faq.a: It depends on villa size, usage and how much salt spray hits your specific plot. Most cliff-top villas do well with weekly or fortnightly visits; we'll suggest a cadence after seeing your setup.

faq.q: What happens if I'm abroad for a month?
faq.a: We keep visiting on schedule and send you the WhatsApp photo report each time, so you can check water clarity and equipment condition from anywhere without being on-site.

faq.q: Do you handle pump or filter replacements as part of the service?
faq.a: If a pressure switch, seal or filter cartridge is wearing out during a routine check, we flag it in your report and arrange the fix. Pricing depends on the part and job scope — just send photos on WhatsApp for a quote.
